content: Nawu Adam Benkebmawahmeng, Kaluk Noah Dorrengh.
Kuhni wanjh kabimdi kabenyolyolme Adam nuye nawu benbornang dja nawu benkebmawahmeng. Bu God benmarnbom bininj, wanjh benmarnbom bu kabirrirohrok nungka nawu God.
Benmarnbom bininj dja daluk, benmarneyimeng kunmak kunwok, dja benngeykurrmeng “Bininj”.
Bu Adam mimbini mandjewk 130, wanjh bibornang beywurd nawu nungka benerohrokni, dja bingeykurrmeng Seth.
Dja bu Seth danginj, Adam djahdjalmimbini mandjewk 800, dja benbalbornabornang birribuyika bebeywurd mak ngalbebeywurd.
Wanjh mandjewk nuyeni rowk Adam bu mimbini wanjh nine hundred dja thirty, wanjh doweng.
Bu Seth mimbini mandjewk 105, wanjh bibornang nawu Enosh.
Dja bu Enosh danginj, Seth djahdjalmimbini mandjewk 807, dja benbalbornabornang birribuyika bebeywurd mak ngalbebeywurd.
Wanjh mandjewk nuyeni rowk Seth bu mimbini wanjh 912, wanjh doweng.
Bu Enosh mimbini mandjewk 90, wanjh bibornang Kenan.
Dja bu Kenan danginj, Enosh djahdjalmimbini mandjewk eight 815 mak benbalbornabornang birribuyika bebeywurd mak ngalbebeywurd.
Wanjh mandjewk nuyeni rowk Enosh bu mimbini wanjh 904, wanjh doweng.
Bu Kenan mimbini mandjewk 70, wanjh bibornang Mahalalel.
Dja bu Mahalalel danginj Kenan djahdjalmimbini mandjewk 840, dja benbalbornabornang birribuyika bebeywurd mak ngalbebeywurd.
Wanjh mandjewk nuyeni rowk Kenan bu mimbini wanjh 910, wanjh doweng.
Bu Mahalalel mimbini mandjewk 65, wanjh bibornang Jared.
Bu Jared danginj, Mahalalel djahdjalmimbini bu mandjewk 830, dja benbalbornabornang birribuyika bebeywurd mak ngalbebeywurd.
Wanjh mandjewk nuyeni rowk Mahalalel bu mimbini wanjh 895, wanjh doweng.
Bu Jared mimbini mandjewk 162, wanjh bibornang Enoch.
Dja bu Enoch danginj, Jared djahdjalmimbini mandjewk 800, dja benbalbornabornang birribuyika bebeywurd mak ngalbebeywurd.
Wanjh mandjewk nuyeni rowk Jared bu mimbini wanjh 962, wanjh doweng.
Bu Enoch mimbini mandjewk 65, wanjh bibornang Methuselah.
Dja bu Methuselah danginj, Enoch munguyh benehdjaldjarrkrey God bu mandjewk 300, dja benbalbornabornang birribuyika bebeywurd mak ngalbebeywurd.
Wanjh mandjewk nuyeni rowk Enoch bu mimbini wanjh 365.
Enoch benehdjarrkrey God, kaluk baldjalyakminj, dja God birrarrkidmey bikang.
Bu Methuselah mimbini mandjewk one 187, nungka bibornang Lamech.
Dja bu Lamech danginj, Methuselah djahdjalmimbini mandjewk 782, dja benbalbornabornang birribuyika bebeywurd mak ngalbebeywurd.
Wanjh mandjewk nuyeni rowk Methuselah bu mimbini wanjh 969, wanjh doweng.
Bu Lamech mimbini mandjewk 182, wanjh nungka bibornang beywurd, dja bingeykurrmeng Noah
, mak yimeng, “Nungka kaluk kankangemarnbun kadberre, bu karrihdurrkmirri dja mak karrihngudjngarrhme bulkkidj duninjh, bu karribolkyilkbun kunrorre, manbu Yawey marnbom kunyid.”
Dja bu Noah danginj, Lamech djahdjalmimbini mandjewk 595 dja benbalbornabornang birribuyika bebeywurd mak ngalbebeywurd.
Wanjh mandjewk nuyeni rowk Lamech bu mimbini wanjh 777, wanjh doweng.
Bu Noah mimbini mandjewk 500, wanjh benbornang Shem, Ham dja Japheth.

footnotes.text: Bu Hebrew kunwok kayime “bibornang” wanjh yikahwi kamenyime “bimawahmeng”.
-29 Kore Hebrew kunwok, mahni kunngey “Noah” kawokyime “kankangemarnbun”.
